تلتقطون (form VIII)
# تَلْتَقِطُونَ (taltaqiṭūna) /tal.ta.qi.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# تُلْتَقَطُونَ (tultaqaṭūna) /tul.ta.qa.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
